name: Dunaföldvár (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Dunaföldvár (a crowned blue and green shield with a white castle, a bunch of grapes and a bird) below the name DUNAFÖLDVÁR in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
